purpose: Teach: 脚光/全盛期/迷走/イジメ/争奪/自尊心/趨勢/再犯

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、注目の脚光を浴びた作家の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura — you chose a writer who'd gained real attention for your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, measured interest. Slight upward lift on her name — genuine recognition. Paced like a mentor reviewing work she's impressed by, not interrogating.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、芸能界の全盛期を支えたスタッフを論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on the staff members who supported the entertainment industry at its peak.
lines.style: Clear and direct, but not stiff. A small hint of pride beneath the formality — she's thought carefully about this. Steady pacing, grounded.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 政策が迷走した時期の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you looked at a period when policy direction became uncertain — that was your research angle?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before continuing. Not leading — genuinely curious how the student framed it. Reflective tone, letting space breathe between phrases.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、学校でのイジメ対策を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined bullying prevention measures in schools.
lines.style: Confident, assured. Direct eye contact in the voice. She's moved past hesitation — this topic matters to her. Slightly more weight on 'prevention.'

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 資源の争奪戦の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your fourth paper traced the history of resource competition — how different groups fought for control?
lines.style: Genuinely engaged now. A slight lean forward in tone. Faster pacing than before — the conversation's momentum building. She's connecting threads.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、自尊心と社会的成功の関係を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I explored the relationship between self-esteem and social success.
lines.style: Quieter than before. More personal. She's revealing something about why these topics matter to her. Careful pacing, slight warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 世論の趨勢を分析した研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And for your last paper, you analyzed how public opinion shifts — the trends driving change?
lines.style: Leaning back slightly. Reflective, drawing the conversation toward its close. Warm curiosity, no rush. Acknowledging the weight of what she's heard.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、犯罪再犯防止プログラムを論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on rehabilitation programs that reduce reoffending.
lines.style: Final statement with quiet gravity. She's come full circle — from entertainment to prevention to rehabilitation. Slower pace. Conviction without performance. A gentle close.
